info.title: E-Commerce API
info.description: Tài liệu API cho hệ thống E-commerce (Catalog, Inventory, Order, v.v...)

hasPassword.description: Whether the account can log in with a password

googleLinked.description: Whether a Google account is linked

displayName.description: New display name: 1 to 100 visible characters (spaces are tidied)

phone.description: 10 digits starting with 0; +84 and separators are accepted

wardCode.description: Code of the ward, commune or special zone (from GET /locations/provinces/:code/wards); the province follows from it

label.description: A name for the address, such as "Nhà" or "Công ty" (at most 50 characters)

isDefault.description: Make this the default address (the first address is always the default)

wardCode.description: Another ward; the province follows from it

verificationRequired.description: Always true: the account is created only after the emailed code is entered (POST /auth/verify-email)

resendAvailableInSeconds.description: Seconds to wait before another code can be requested

verificationExpiresInSeconds.description: Seconds the registration is kept. After that the user must register again; asking for another code will not help

code.description: The 6-digit code sent to the email address

resendAvailableInSeconds.description: Seconds to wait before another code can be requested
Seconds to wait before another reset code can be requested. The same answer is given whether or not the address has an account

code.description: The 6-digit code sent to the email address

refreshToken.description: Ignored. Kept so existing clients keep working.

deviceName.description: Device, as the User-Agent it logged in with

ipAddress.description: IP of the most recent use

lastUsedAt.description: Last time this device refreshed its token

current.description: True for the session making this request

idToken.description: The `credential` Google Identity Services hands to the page (a JWT signed by Google)

nonce.description: The nonce given to Google when signing in, if any. Required to match when the token carries one

isNewUser.description: True when this sign-in created the account (a good moment to ask for a profile)

idToken.description: The `credential` Google Identity Services hands to the page (a JWT signed by Google)

nonce.description: The nonce given to Google when signing in, if any. Required to match when the token carries one

currentPassword.description: The password of the account. Required when the account has one: it proves the owner is asking, which a stolen access token cannot

total.description: How many products match, counted only up to 1000

price.description: The selling price: the price that is charged

compareAtPrice.description: The price before a discount, shown crossed out. Display only: money is always charged at price

discountPercent.description: How much cheaper than compareAtPrice, in whole percent; 0 when not discounted

inStock.description: In stock now (onHand above 0; units held for orders are not taken off). Only in the public endpoints.

minPrice.description: The lowest price among the SKUs ("from ... VND")

onSale.description: Some SKU is sold below its original price

discountPercent.description: The biggest discount among the SKUs, in whole percent; 0 when none

inStock.description: Some SKU is in stock now. Only in the public endpoints; false means "out of stock".

count.description: Published products in the category and every category below it, inside the filters

compareAtPrice.description: Giá trước khi giảm (hiển thị gạch ngang); phải lớn hơn price. Chỉ để hiển thị, tiền vẫn tính theo price

attributes.description: Thuộc tính cấu hình của SKU

description.description: Mô tả chi tiết sản phẩm

skus.description: Danh sách các phiên bản (SKU) của sản phẩm

compareAtPrice.description: The price before a discount (shown crossed out); must be greater than price. Display only: money is always charged at price
The price before a discount (shown crossed out), greater than price. A number sets it, null removes the discount, leaving it out keeps what is there. Display only: money is always charged at price

parentId.description: ID của danh mục cha (nếu có)

newParentId.description: ID of the new parent category. Send null or omit to move to root.

price.description: The price now; null when the item is no longer on sale

addedPrice.description: The price when it was put in the cart

available.description: Units that can be sold now; null when the item is no longer on sale

subtotal.description: Total of the lines that can be ordered as they are

quantity.description: Units to ADD to what the cart already holds for this SKU
Units in the cart for this SKU after the change

addedPrice.description: The price the cart recorded for this SKU

quantity.description: The units the cart should hold for this SKU (it replaces the old number; sending it again changes nothing)

addressId.description: One of the addresses in your address book

paymentMethod.description: ONLINE: pay before delivery, 15 minutes from now. COD: pay in cash on delivery; the order is confirmed at once.

unitPrice.description: The price when the order was placed

expiresAt.description: Online orders: when the time to pay runs out. Meaningless for cash on delivery.

itemCount.description: How many lines the order has

items.description: The first 3 items, enough to show what the order is about

amount.description: What the customer has to pay (VND)

payUrl.description: Where to pay. Only while the payment is INITIATED; null in every other state.

expiresAt.description: The customer has until this moment to pay

amount.description: What the fake gateway says it collected. Leave it out to pay the right amount; send another number to try a wrong amount.

webhookStatus.description: The HTTP status our own webhook endpoint answered

eventId.description: The id of the webhook message that was sent
